title: maven_rules.bzl: classifier doesn't seem to be handled correctly

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

body:
With the current `tools/build_defs/repo/maven_rules.bzl` I would expect, that something like this just works:

WORKSPACE (copied original maven_rules.bzl version locally):

```
load("//tools:maven_rules.bzl", "maven_jar",
     "maven_dependency_plugin")

maven_dependency_plugin()

maven_jar(
    name = "jetty_server",
    artifact = "org.eclipse.jetty:jetty-server:9.3.11.v20160721",
    sha1 = "d932e0dc1e9bd4839ae446754615163d60271a66",
)

maven_jar(
    name = "jetty_server_sources",
    artifact = "org.eclipse.jetty:jetty-server:9.3.11.v20160721:jar:sources",
    sha1 = "b23cac190808baed928260b2c9beca3b1ed232b4",
)

maven_jar(
    name = "jetty_server_javadoc",
    artifact = "org.eclipse.jetty:jetty-server:9.3.11.v20160721:jar:javadoc",
    sha1 = "b5f893599bc952f3b1f5de010438c074fce3a810",
)
```

BUILD:

```
java_library(
  name = "jetty-server",
  exports = ["@jetty_server//jar"],
)

java_library(
  name = "jetty-server-sources",
  exports = ["@jetty_server_sources//jar"],
)

java_library(
  name = "jetty-server-javadoc",
  exports = ["@jetty_server_javadoc//jar"],
)
```

And running this command:

```
  $ bazel build ...
```

Should produce this result:

```
$ ls -R $(bazel info output_base)/external/jetty_server*
/home/davido/.cache/bazel/_bazel_davido/54ba95cab527185f25de375068b40a77/external/jetty_server:
jar  WORKSPACE

/home/davido/.cache/bazel/_bazel_davido/54ba95cab527185f25de375068b40a77/external/jetty_server/jar:
BUILD  jetty-server-9.3.11.v20160721.jar

/home/davido/.cache/bazel/_bazel_davido/54ba95cab527185f25de375068b40a77/external/jetty_server_javadoc:
jar  WORKSPACE

/home/davido/.cache/bazel/_bazel_davido/54ba95cab527185f25de375068b40a77/external/jetty_server_javadoc/jar:
BUILD  jetty-server-9.3.11.v20160721-javadoc.jar

/home/davido/.cache/bazel/_bazel_davido/54ba95cab527185f25de375068b40a77/external/jetty_server_sources:
jar  WORKSPACE

/home/davido/.cache/bazel/_bazel_davido/54ba95cab527185f25de375068b40a77/external/jetty_server_sources/jar:
BUILD  jetty-server-9.3.11.v20160721-sources.jar
```
